authority_comparison.verification_command:
python3 - <<'PYTHON'
import hashlib, json, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
record = json.loads(Path("000-docs/038-AA-AUDR-topology-authority-and-delivery-2026-10-27.evidence.json").read_text())["authority_comparison"]
for path, expected in record["sha256_by_path"].items():
    for revision in (record["earlier_commit"], record["later_commit"]):
        actual = subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", revision + ":" + path])
        assert hashlib.sha256(actual).hexdigest() == expected, (revision, path)
paths = subprocess.check_output(["git", "diff", "--name-only", record["earlier_commit"], record["later_commit"]], text=True).splitlines()
assert paths == record["changed_paths"]
assert all(path.startswith("changelogs/") for path in paths)
print("7 authority files match at both full commits; all intervening changed paths are under changelogs/.")
PYTHON
